emotional_tone: Cutting-edge, highly technical, immersive, and intelligent.

headings.usage: Use for primary marketing copy, app headers, and command palette titles.

body.usage: Standard UI text, chat messages, settings labels.

mono_code.usage: Code blocks, live preview artifacts, typing indicator status ('Thinking...'), and tech-heavy badges.

typography.hierarchy_rules: Max heading size text-5xl for workspace context. Do not use generic fonts like Inter or Roboto.

colors.usage_rules: Do NOT use pure #000000. Tint black slightly. Do not use Teal (#1B93A4) or Purple. Laser Green used exclusively for 'Generating...' success states. Cyber Yellow for Search Grounding citations.

surfaces_and_textures.workspace_panels: Retro-Futurism: Flat #0A0A0A background with 1px solid border-white/10. No soft shadows. Crisp edges.
surfaces_and_textures.command_palette_overlay: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-2xl and 1px border-white/10.
surfaces_and_textures.chat_bubbles: User: bg-white/5 border-white/10. AI: transparent background with glowing left-border (e.g. border-l-2 border-blue-500).
surfaces_and_textures.buttons: Flat surfaces with sharp hover states. Primary CTA: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: The 'Control Room' Grid Protocol. Highly structured, dense yet clean.
layout_and_spacing.structure: Two main panels: Left (Chat/Controls) takes 30-40% width. Right (Live Render Preview) takes 60-70% width.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use padding p-4 or p-6 inside panels. Add gap-4 between chat messages. The header is h-14 or h-16 with px-4.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Expose the skeleton. Panels are separated by solid 1px border-white/10.

motion_and_interactions.typing_indicator: Use Framer Motion to animate status text ('Thinking...', 'Initializing...', 'Generating...'). Add a subtle pulsing glow using drop-shadow with the respective color (Yellow, Cyan, Green).
motion_and_interactions.artifacts_tabs: Smooth layout transitions between 'Preview' and 'Code' using framer-motion AnimatePresence and layoutId.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons and interactive elements must change background lightness on hover and retain high contrast.

components_strategy.shadcn_ui: Use Shadcn Button, Card, Input, Badge, Tabs, ScrollArea, Separator, Skeleton, Switch, Slider.
components_strategy.customization: Strip default Vercel-like rounded borders. Enforce radius 'rounded-md' or 'rounded-none' for a sharper, technical feel.
components_strategy.lucide_react: Use for all icons (e.g., Bot, User, Code, Play, Search, Command, Settings).
components_strategy.react_live: Implement custom styling for the LiveProvider/LivePreview wrapper to feel like a high-end IDE.

landing_hero_background.description: Abstract dark building cubes for login/landing background to provide a technical, architectural depth.

fallback_texture.description: Abstract wavy dark shapes for empty states or loading screens.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles, tab triggers, send buttons) MUST include a data-testid attribute.
accessibility_and_testing.examples: data-testid='send-message-button', data-testid='chat-input', data-testid='tab-code-view', data-testid='cmd-palette-trigger', data-testid='login-button', data-testid='gemini-mode-switch'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize React components using .jsx/.js as strictly instructed by user environment preferences.
Ensure the layout is a strict two-column design: Left for chat, Right for react-live rendering.
Install required dependencies: framer-motion, lucide-react, react-live, cmdk (or shadcn command).
Integrate Google Sign-In on a landing page utilizing the abstract dark cube background.
Set up the Gemini options switch in the header (Flash, Thinking, Grounding) with visually distinct active states.
Ensure the typing indicator clearly transitions between 'Thinking...', 'Initializing...', and 'Generating...' with appropriate neon glowing accents.
Implement the CMD+K command palette using framer-motion and the Crystal Glassmorphism style.
Ensure all UI is built strictly with the provided typography and color guidelines. DO NOT USE Inter font.
Add data-testid attributes to EVERY interactive component.
